reviewer: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) with a fresh-context medium reviewer subagent

claims.summary: Exposed degree occupancy: in lem:high-incidence-occupancy's charged character window (any graph, multigraphs included), for an edge set T, |T| = tau, with 2K + tau <= 2D and 4K < m - tau, and any vertex set V_hi, let theta(u) and mu(u) be the numbers of edges of T at u and of off-T edges from u to V_hi (u outside V_hi), nu = max_u (theta(u) + 2 mu(u)), X_0 the exposed vertices (those of V_hi with an off-T edge), and for x in X_0 g(x) = s(x) - kappa(x), its off-T edges minus those ending in V_hi (loops counted there). Then q_T(K) >= (1 - eta_ex) B_(m-tau)(K) with eta_ex = (1 + 2 beta_T^(epsilon - nu))^n prod_(x in X_0) (1 + 2 beta_T^(g(x))) - 1, beta_T = 2 sqrt(K/(m - tau)): a potential's nonzero values at exposed vertices are charged by their own off-T edges, d'_s >= (epsilon - nu) sigma + sum_(x in X) g(x), so a coset holds at most one good character and no factor 3^(h') is paid; eta_ex < 1 forces epsilon > nu and every g(x) >= 1. Closing any Y of X_0 (T_Y = T with the off-T edges at Y) gives q_T(K) >= q_(T_Y)(K) >= (1 - eta_Y) B_(m - tau_Y)(K) under 2K + tau_Y <= 2D, the star closure route at Y = X_0.
claims.assessment: Working proof by lem:high-incidence-occupancy's argument with a second disjoint family of cut edges at the exposed vertices, per vertex, under the weaker 2K + tau <= 2D its collision step needs.
claims.rationale: Removes the factor 3^(h') of lem:exposed-vertex-occupancy without closing T, when exposed vertices keep more off-T edges than they send into V_hi, at the cost of mu(u) twice in the expansion exponent; the general-step review's opening lemma for the Repair Pang block.
claims.next_action: The decisive test's per-pair occupancy for cosets of the cut space plus the span of disjoint pair exponents.

claims.summary: Exposed degree tuple ratio: in lem:local-tuple-ratio's setting (components E_i = P_i m_(gamma_i), P_i functions of the states of T, e_max + K <= D, K + tau + |supp gamma_i| <= D), with c(K) > 0, 4K < m - tau and lem:exposed-degree-occupancy's eta_ex < 1, for 0 <= d <= K: (i) c(K-d)/c(K) <= (1 - eta_ex)^(-1) B_(m-tau)(K-d)/B_(m-tau)(K); (ii) with lambda, q rho < 1 of lem:ball-ratio-comparison at n = m, tau, k = K >= 1 and eta_occ < 1 of lem:cut-ball-occupancy at level K - d, c(K-d)/c(K) <= lambda^d/((1 - eta_ex)(1 - eta_occ)) h(K-d)/h(K); (iii) the same for T_Y, Y within the exposed vertices, when K + tau_Y + |supp gamma_i| <= D, cor:star-closure-ratio's factor at Y = all exposed vertices with A = V_hi; r components: r times the largest. On the power-growing charged family, for tau <= D - K - |supp gamma|, nu <= Delta/8 and margins g(x) >= Delta/8, the factor is at most 2r e^(9.5 tau d/(n Delta)) over canonical, as cor:star-closure-ratio gives for closures inside the window, now also for edge sets whose star closure leaves it (more than (D - K - |supp gamma| - tau)/(2 Delta) exposed vertices).
claims.assessment: Working composition of lem:local-tuple-ratio's ratio step with the new occupancy count at every level k <= K, and of cor:star-closure-ratio's passage to the canonical ratio through lem:ball-ratio-comparison and lem:cut-ball-occupancy.
claims.rationale: Gives cor:star-closure-ratio's polynomial factor for edge sets inside the window whose star closure leaves it, when exposed vertices keep a margin of off-T edges.
claims.next_action: The decisive test's per-pair occupancy for cosets of the cut space plus the span of disjoint pair exponents, beyond the window.
